statements.t: Although we remain optimistic regarding overall construction demand in the future, certain large construction projects have experienced delays for various reasons, including securing permits, and we are monitoring indications that Texas’ residential construction is beginning to slow down.
We estimate that the construction costs of the Texas kiln project will total approximately $65 million.

The new kiln began intermittently producing quicklime in the third quarter and we expect to have final commissioning completed in the fourth quarter, at which point we will begin to depreciate the new kiln and related equipment.
As of September 30, 2026, we were committed to $2.8 million of open purchase orders related to the Texas kiln project.
As of September 30, 2026, we had incurred a total of $61.0 million on the Texas kiln project, of which $60.4 million had been paid in cash.

At September 30, 2026, we had no debt outstanding and no draws on the Revolving Facility other than $4.6 million of letters of credit, principally related to the Texas kiln project, which count as draws against the available commitment under the Revolving Facility.

“Although we remain optimistic regarding overall construction demand in the future, certain large construction projects have recently experienced delays for various reasons, including securing permits, and we are monitoring indications that Texas’ residential construction is beginning to slow down.
The new kiln at our Texas facility began intermittently producing quicklime in the third quarter, and we expect to have final commissioning completed in the fourth quarter.
